summary: This is one of a group of Chinese cushion covers and textile fragments that belonged to Viscount Garnet Wolseley (1833-1913). During the Second Opium War, he served as a Lieutenant-Colonel in the combined British and French forces. In October 1860 this army plundered and destroyed the Summer Palace
